_comment: Editorial content for MLCF. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: the CC-licensed cement-plant photographs available are of plants elsewhere, and using one would state — without saying it — that the picture is of Maple Leaf's facility.
description: Maple Leaf Cement Factory Limited is a Pakistani cement producer established in 1956 through a collaboration between the West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation and the Government of Canada. It operates the country's largest single-site cement production facility, at Iskanderabad in district Mianwali, with four grey-cement production lines and a dedicated white-cement line, and total installed clinker capacity of 7.8 million tonnes a year. The company is a key entity within the Kohinoor Maple Leaf Group.

products.name: Ordinary Portland Cement
products.summary: Grey cement for mortar and concrete in general construction, such as houses and buildings.

products.name: Sulphate Resistant Cement (SRC)
products.summary: A waterproofing cement with tri-calcium aluminate held below 5%, for basements, deep foundations, canal lining, waterways and dams.

products.name: Low Alkali Cement
products.summary: Cement that resists the alkali-silica reaction, used in moisture-resistant construction such as airports, runways and dams.

products.name: White Cement
products.summary: White Portland cement for decorative work and prestige projects, typically precast cladding panels.

products.name: Wall Coat
products.summary: A three-in-one base coat, primer and matte finish for cement-plastered walls and ceilings.
